title: Agent Model Policy Overlay v1
description: Operator-editable, validated JSON overlay that selects the agent roster's models by applying one built-in template. Missing file = library defaults (the 'balanced' template); an invalid file is a loud typed error, never a silent fallback (missing != invalid). One policy governs both agent projections (.claude/agents/*.md and .codex/agents/*.toml). Semantic checks (a known template id) are enforced by the store, beyond this structural schema.

applied_template.description: Id of the built-in template applied as the roster base (e.g. 'balanced', 'max-quality'). Omit to base on the library default ('balanced'). An unknown id is a hard validation error.
